_comment: WC-TW-6c LHCI ratchet: medians of 3 runs on the CI production build. While a median is over its absolute error threshold the gate asserts median <= baseline x (1 + tolerance) and the absolute threshold is a warning; lower these in every reduction PR.
source: booking-perf run 39741527677 (PR #123 head a6e4c6b627, WC-TW-6c-4), region=gh-runner

regions._comment: WC-TW-6c-10 per-region ratchet. lcp_ms = measured median for that region. tbt_ms is CPU-only (RTT does not change it), so it carries the gh-runner TBT baseline; a single region sample swings 830-1470 ms.

tbt_note: TBT is CPU-bound and swings 557-1515 ms run to run on GH runners at the same code (main 319c67a063: runs 40490460276=607, 40507644481=1294, 40491804089=1515; PR #182: 40516243793=829). A single-run baseline (746, run 39741527677) made the ratchet noise and main red; tbt_ms carries the top of the observed spread, same as the region baselines. Bundle regressions are hard-gated by perf/js-baseline.json.
